record.question: What is the chapter name for Chapter 16 in ICD-10?
options: Certain conditions originating in the perinatal period
Symptoms, signs and abnormal clinical and laboratory findings
record.explanation: Answer B: Certain conditions originating in the perinatal period. ICD-10 Chapter XVI covers certain conditions originating in the perinatal period. Reference: https://icd.who.int/browse10/2019/en. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
